title: Naturally Aerated Malaysian Bottarga Satay
description: A resinous and adventurous Malaysian dish featuring bottarga, spherified and served in a terracotta dish, this recipe is sugar-free-friendly and perfect for those looking to try something new.
instructions: In a blender, combine coconut milk, lime juice, fish sauce, and sodium alginate, and blend until smooth.
Strain the mixture into a bowl and whisk in the grated bottarga.
Using a syringe, drop the mixture into a bath of cold water to spherify.
Once the spherified bottarga is set, remove it from the water and drain off excess liquid.
In a small saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the salt and black pepper.
Add the spherified bottarga to the saucepan and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until lightly browned.
To serve, place the bottarga satay in a terracotta dish and garnish with pandan leaves.
To add a smoky flavor, cook the bottarga satay over a grill or under a broiler for an additional 2 minutes.
